summary: This Wikipedia-derived note is a broad biography of Beyoncé, the American singer, songwriter, producer and actress. It covers her early life in Houston and rise with Destiny's Child, her solo albums and film roles, her marriage to Jay Z, Tidal ownership, endorsements and fashion ventures, awards and charitable work. The text contains duplicated passages and some sections on her 2012-2016 activities.
one_line: Wikipedia-based overview of Beyoncé's life, music albums, films, awards, endorsements, business ventures and charity work.
key_facts: Beyoncé Giselle Knowles-Carter was born September 4, 1981, and is an American singer, songwriter, record producer and actress born and raised in Houston, Texas.
Beyoncé rose to fame in the late 1990s as lead singer of R&B girl-group Destiny's Child, which was managed by her father Mathew Knowles.
Dangerously in Love, released June 24, 2003, debuted atop the Billboard 200 and earned five Grammy Awards, with the number-one singles "Crazy in Love" and "Baby Boy".
At the 2010 Grammys Beyoncé won six awards in one night, including Song of the Year for "Single Ladies (Put a Ring on It)".

Beyoncé performed at the Super Bowl XLVII halftime show in February 2013 at the Mercedes-Benz Superdome in New Orleans, which the note calls the second most tweeted moment in history at 268,000 tweets per minute.
Beyoncé's feature-length documentary Life Is But a Dream first aired on HBO on February 16, 2013, and she directed and produced it herself.
On January 7, 2012, Beyoncé gave birth to her first child, daughter Blue Ivy Carter, at Lenox Hill Hospital in New York.
Beyoncé and Jay Z were married without publicity on April 4, 2008.
Beyoncé's second solo album B'Day was released September 5, 2006, and sold 541,000 copies in its first week.
Beyoncé starred as blues singer Etta James in the 2008 biopic Cadillac Records and was nominated for a Satellite Award for Best Supporting Actress for the role.
In 2012 Beyoncé signed a $50 million deal to endorse Pepsi, which the Center for Science in the Public Interest criticised in an open letter.
On March 30, 2015, it was announced that Beyoncé is a co-owner, with other artists, of the music streaming service Tidal.
Beyoncé has won 20 Grammy Awards and has 52 Grammy nominations, the most of any woman in Grammy history according to the note.
Beyoncé names Michael Jackson as her major musical influence and said at the 2006 World Music Awards that she would never have performed without him.
Beyoncé has sold over 118 million records worldwide as a solo artist, plus 60 million with Destiny's Child, according to the note.
